text:
infra-oncall: noticing a spike in apiserver 5xx in eu-west1, started ~11:12Z. Controller-manager reconcile queue growing and GPU attach failures ~18%. tagging @arjun @sofia :eyes:

mike: can you paste etcd logs around the compaction timeframe?

sofia: grabbing logs from node-2, compaction kicked at 2026-03-21T11:12:03Z — seeing a long pause and multiple fsync stalls:
```
etcdserver: compacted at 18500, compaction took 1.85s
wal: fsync: write took 1800ms
etcdserver: leadership transfer: stepping down due to leader lease wait
```

arjun: that explains it — compaction + fsync stall triggered a leader stepdown. followers tried to catch up -> apiserver loses leader -> 503s cascade. NVMe IOPS looked saturated on node-2.

jess: controller-manager shows reconcile backlog and attach errors around the same time:
```
ERROR attach_controller: failed to attach GPU to node-3: timeout waiting for device; attempts=4
```

mike: ops-bot, any scheduled jobs in eu-west around 11:12Z?

ops-bot: scheduled-job-runner: snapshot-backup-eu-west started at 2026-03-21T11:12:01Z on node-2 (job-id sj-449).

arjun: so we had snapshot + etcd compaction overlapping on same host — classic IO collision. Short-term mitigations I propose:
1) temporarily pause compaction on node-2 or adjust compaction window
2) throttle snapshot jobs in eu-west (stagger start times)
3) pin etcd leader to a higher-IO node until we audit disks
4) throttle GPU provisioning (reduce concurrent attaches) for 10-30m to drain backlog

sofia: +1. I can bump etcd election timeout to 5s cluster-wide as emergency to avoid leader flips, and then stagger compaction across members. I'll test change in eu-west1-dev first.

jess: I'll push a slow rollout for the provisioner flag: max-concurrent-attaches: 10 -> 5. That should reduce attach bursts.

infra-oncall: plan: sofia bumps electionTimeout -> jess reduces concurrent attaches -> mike routes 30% traffic to us-west as safety -> arjun runs disk iops audit and opens follow-up. I'll open an incident ticket and coordinate. INC ticket: https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2026-349 :tophat:

mike: started partial routing (30% -> us-west). watching 5xx graphs. :eyes: 

sofia: electionTimeout bumped to 5s in eu-west prod at 2026-03-21T11:25Z (canary->prod). leader hold time improved on measurement.

jess: provisioner flag rolled to 50% at 11:26Z, now at 100% for eu-west first wave. attach failures down from 18% -> 4% in last 5m.

infra-oncall: 5xx now down to 1.2% last 5m. keeping emergency knobs in place for 1h, then revert electionTimeout change and schedule audit window for compaction/snapshot timing. Good catch team. :thumbsup: 

arjun: follow-ups I filed: add an alert for compaction+snapshot overlap, implement compaction spread across members, perform NVMe firmware check and IOPS baseline, consider moving snapshots off primary NVMe if possible. Assign to storage team (storeng).

ops-bot: INC-2026-349 created and linked to this thread.

infra-oncall: closing operational loop here — will update the INC with timelines and postmortem notes once audit completes. Thanks everyone.
